description: Estadísticas Edificación año is a series of datasets listed in Chilean national open data portal (datos.gob.cl), an open data portal, published or maintained by Municipalidad de La Reina. Estadísticas año 2019 de Permisos de Edificación, Permisos de Obra Menor, Anteproyectos, y Certificados de Regularización Ley N° 20.898, elaboradas por la Dirección de Obras Municipales. Coverage: Municipalidad de La Reina. The portal lists 4 near-identical datasets in this series (one per year, month, area or site), grouped in this record; the first few are linked. The portal files it under the publisher Municipalidad de La Reina. Its tags are Anteproyectos, Obras Municipales, Permisos Edificación, Permisos Obra Menor. It offers 12 resource(s) in XLSX. The portal shows 2020-01-20 as the last update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY (version not stated). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support infrastructure planning and operations studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-am-cl-portal.
